exZh: 该慈善机构发起了一项活动，以提高人们对心理健康的认识。

ex: The letters were kept in a private drawer away from prying eyes.
exZh: 这些信件被保存在一个私人的抽屉里，避开了窥探的目光。

ex: She paused for a moment to collect her thoughts before speaking.
exZh: 在开口说话之前，她停顿了一下以整理思绪。

ex: Everyone in the team worked hard to achieve the project goals.
exZh: 团队中的每个人都努力工作以实现项目目标。

ex: Don't forget to lock the door when you leave the house.
exZh: 出门时别忘了锁门。

ex: Please turn to page fifty-four of your textbook for the diagram.
exZh: 请翻到教科书的第54页查看图表。

ex: Parents often worry about their children's safety when they go out.
exZh: 当孩子们外出时，父母常常担心他们的安全。

ex: We usually spend our summer holidays at the beach with family.
exZh: 我们通常和家人一起在海滩度过暑假。

ex: It is important to drink plenty of water during hot weather.
exZh: 在炎热的天气里，多喝水是很重要的。

ex: In my opinion, the new policy will benefit the local community.
exZh: 在我看来，新政策将有利于当地社区。

ex: They decided to park the car near the entrance of the mall.
exZh: 他们决定把车停在商场入口附近。

ex: The red lines on the map represent the main railway routes.
exZh: 地图上的红线代表主要铁路线路。

ex: Education is the key to unlocking many opportunities in life.
exZh: 教育是开启人生中许多机遇的关键。

ex: Please wait inside the building until the rain stops completely.
exZh: 请在楼内等候，直到雨完全停下来。

zh: 站立、忍受、处于某种状态
ex: He could no longer stand the constant noise coming from the construction site.
exZh: 他再也无法忍受建筑工地传来的持续噪音。

ex: The team spent the whole week preparing the comprehensive presentation for investors.
exZh: 团队花了一整周时间为投资者准备这份详尽的汇报。

ex: Natural light poured through the large windows, brightening up the entire room.
exZh: 自然光透过大窗户洒进来，照亮了整个房间。

ex: She received a formal letter confirming her acceptance into the graduate program.
exZh: 她收到了一封正式信函，确认她被研究生项目录取。

ex: The professor introduced a fascinating subject that sparked a lively debate among students.
exZh: 教授介绍了一个引人入胜的主题，引发了学生们的热烈讨论。

ex: Attending the evening class helped her improve her technical and analytical skills.
exZh: 参加晚间课程帮助她提高了专业和分析技能。

ex: Rapid technological development has transformed the way people communicate globally.
exZh: 技术的飞速发展改变了全球人们的交流方式。

ex: They moved from a bustling city to a quiet coastal town last year.
exZh: 他们去年从繁华的都市搬到了一个宁静的海滨小镇。

ex: More than half of the participants preferred the flexible working arrangement.
exZh: 超过半数的参与者更倾向于灵活的办公安排。

ex: Please give me a minute to review these documents before the meeting begins.
exZh: 在会议开始前，请给我一分钟时间查看这些文件。

ex: We decided to take a short break after working continuously for three hours.
exZh: 连续工作三个小时后，我们决定短暂休息一下。

ex: The manager gave clear instructions on how to handle urgent customer inquiries.
exZh: 经理就如何处理紧急客户咨询给出了明确的指示。

ex: Investing in renewable energy is crucial for the sustainable future of our planet.
exZh: 投资可再生能源对于我们星球的可持续未来至关重要。

ex: You can choose either the online course or the weekend workshop for training.
exZh: 你可以选择在线课程或周末工作坊来进行培训。

ex: The research project was initiated several months ago with a generous grant.
exZh: 这项研究项目是几个月前在一笔慷慨资助下启动的。

ex: The vehicle consumes approximately seven liters of fuel per hundred kilometers.
exZh: 该车每百公里大约消耗七升燃油。

ex: Despite facing intense pressure, the negotiator managed to remain calm and objective.
exZh: 尽管面临巨大压力，谈判代表仍设法保持冷静和客观。

zh: 顶端、顶部、最高的、首位的
ex: She climbed to the top of the corporate ladder through determination and skill.
exZh: 凭借决心和技能，她一步步攀升至公司的最高层。

ex: Collaboration among different research teams led to a major breakthrough in medicine.
exZh: 不同研究团队之间的合作促成了医学领域的重大突破。

ex: The innovative startup managed to win a substantial government contract this year.
exZh: 这家创新型初创公司今年成功赢获了一笔可观的政府合同。

ex: The vibrant color palette chosen for the exhibition attracted visitors of all ages.
exZh: 为展览挑选的鲜艳色调吸引了各个年龄段的参观者。

ex: The new environmental policy will involve strict regulations for local factories.
exZh: 这项新的环境政策将涉及对当地工厂的严格监管。

ex: After hours of intense negotiation, both parties finally managed to reach an agreement.
exZh: 经过数小时的激烈谈判，双方终于达成了一致协议。

ex: Modern social media platforms have fundamentally altered how individuals interact with each other.
exZh: 现代社交媒体平台从根本上改变了人与人之间的互动方式。

ex: The economy experienced a prolonged period of growth following the market reforms.
exZh: 市场改革之后，该国经济经历了一段持续的增长期。

ex: A modern bridge was built across the river to improve regional transportation.
exZh: 河上新建了一座现代化桥梁，以改善区域交通。

ex: Please take careful note of the safety procedures outlined in the handbook.
exZh: 请仔细留意手册中列出的安全操作规程。

ex: Understanding the history of a culture allows us to appreciate its modern customs.
exZh: 了解一种文化的历史能让我们更好地欣赏其现代习俗。

ex: The government launched new initiatives to create sustainable jobs for young graduates.
exZh: 政府推出了多项新举措，为年轻毕业生创造可持续的就业岗位。

ex: A strong ambition to succeed can drive individuals to overcome significant obstacles.
exZh: 对成功的强烈追求能驱使人们克服重大的困难。

ex: We took a peaceful walk along the river bank during the sunset yesterday.
exZh: 昨天日落时分，我们沿着河岸宁静地漫步。

ex: This specific type of material is ideal for building energy-efficient houses.
exZh: 这种特定类型的材料非常适合建造节能住宅。

zh: 声音、听起来、健康的、合理的
ex: The consultant provided sound financial advice that helped the business avoid bankruptcy.
exZh: 顾问提供了合理的财务建议，帮助企业避免了破产。

ex: An expert designer always keeps an eye on the latest industry trends.
exZh: 优秀的设计师总是密切关注最新的行业趋势。

ex: Listening to classical music can enhance concentration and reduce daily stress levels.
exZh: 听古典音乐能够提高专注力并减轻日常压力。

ex: Strategic planning is essential if the team wants to win this crucial game.
exZh: 如果团队想赢得这场关键比赛，战略规划是必不可少的。

ex: The country is undergoing significant political reform to enhance democratic participation.
exZh: 该国正在进行重大的政治改革以增强民主参与。

ex: Students are free to express their unique opinions during the seminar discussions.
exZh: 在研讨会讨论中，学生们可以自由地表达自己的独特观点。

ex: Patients will receive comprehensive medical care under the revised health policy.
exZh: 根据修订后的医疗政策，患者将获得全面的医疗保障。

ex: Winning the international award was a proud moment for the young scientist.
exZh: 获得这项国际大奖是这位年轻科学家无比自豪的时刻。

ex: The retail company reported a dramatic increase in online sales this quarter.
exZh: 这家零售公司报告称本季度线上销售额大幅增长。

ex: The university updated its attendance policy to accommodate students with special needs.
exZh: 该大学更新了出勤政策，以照顾有特殊需求的学生。

ex: The committee agreed that further research is required before implementing the project.
exZh: 委员会一致认为，在实施该项目之前需要进行更深入的研究。

ex: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining a healthy body.
exZh: 规律运动和均衡饮食对于保持健康的体魄至关重要。

ex: Solving such complex engineering problems will require advanced mathematical knowledge and collaboration.
exZh: 解决此类复杂的工程难题需要扎实的高等数学知识和团队合作。

ex: Passengers were advised to wait patiently in the terminal due to flight delays.
exZh: 由于航班延误，乘客被建议在候机楼内耐心等待。

ex: There is a general consensus that renewable energy is vital for our future.
exZh: 人们普遍达成共识，即可再生能源对我们的未来至关重要。

ex: Several unexpected obstacles appear whenever we try to implement the new strategy.
exZh: 每当我们尝试实施新策略时，总会出现几个意想不到的障碍。

ex: She took a decisive step toward achieving her long-term career goals today.
exZh: 今天，她朝向实现自己的长期职业目标迈出了坚实的一步。
